semantic.justification: V4DQJW adds native FastSaxSerializer/FastSerializerHelper text/byte export, original1MiB cache, ordered token/value emission, XML10 and literal x-escape rules, APPEND/PREPEND/POSTPONE marks and original sorted buckets. XmlFilterBase now owns the native fragment-serializer factory with original no-header/VML/+xml predicate. Actual ZipFragmentStream/ZipStorage, OOXML token names and relationship/content-type owners are reused. Caller-provided actual FastTokenHandler replaces native component-service acquisition; no fake global context or token catalog is introduced. UTF16 host strings use the existing UTF8 byte transport binding; no exact claim is made for invalid UTF16 conversion or malformed UTF8 diagnostics. Native debug structural stacks remain unported; output preconditions retain the existing transport errors. File-local native invalidChar is exported only for source-scoped algorithm testing. FastAttributeList/VML raw-attribute overload, native numeric/double overloads and complete DOCX/XLSX export orchestration remain pending. No document/file UI behavior or whole-native parity is claimed; previous statuses and intentional file workflows remain unchanged. Native toUnoSequence reinterprets ByteSequence while CachedOutputStream reuses raw storage. WRITER137/CALC-303 record the possible native retained-sequence alias issue. Actual ZIP storage consumes native byte sequences synchronously and copies at the archive boundary. Physical native Sequence ABI and compiled upstream parity remain unverified; the local native alias contract is exercised. Keep native mbMarkStackEmpty and cache mbWriteToOutStream as separate original flags. mark pushes before fallible cache.setOutput and sets the empty flag only after success; an initial output failure may leave a nonempty stack with a true empty flag. mergeTopMarks follows that original flag, and getData runs before popping. WRITER138/CALC-304 record this preserved error-state asymmetry; a genuine closed ZipFragmentStream test pins it. Native private start/single/attribute-write/byte-write/sort method boundaries are retained. Native serializer byte owners now use genuine SAL ByteSequence/NODEFAULT cache storage, raw nElements mutation and toUnoSequence output aliases. ForMerge/ForSort own actual native sequence values, preserve native realloc/prepend/postpone/sort behavior and copy the merge value before pop. Stack/cache std::shared_ptr lifetime is explicitly lowered to a private local control count with virtual destruction, including failed destination switches. Helper endDocument destroys its moved serializer on success or error. ZipFragmentStream and relationship export consume initialized UNO byte Sequence values; host Uint8Array chunks remain only at the ZIP transport copy boundary. WRITER137/CALC-303 has a local retained-native-value alias witness without a COW correction. Full native output Reference/OWriteStream/parent storage/transaction/service and DOCX/XLSX model/filter/Worker/UI acceptance remain unfinished. Numeric/encoding edge cases, physical allocation/ABI/shared_ptr layout and debug-only guarantees stay unverified. Browser file/persistence policy is unchanged.
